tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, tables, header bar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Table header rows, popovers, hover cards.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented control track, battery bar track, map ground.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative panel and card borders. Not for controls: use border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, chips and secondary buttons. Meets 3:1 against surface and bg in both themes (light 3.43, dark 3.63).

tokens.name: row-line
tokens.usage: Hairline between table rows and list items.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surface (17.8:1 light, 15.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary labels and table cells (9.9:1 light, 10.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Meta text, captions, column headers. Lowest text tone: 5.6:1 on bg light, 6.7:1 on surface dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, focus ring, selected state, battery bars at normal level.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and text on accent-soft (9.8:1 light, 9.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Current nav item, filter chips that are on, info notes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent (7.9:1 light, 7.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: inverse-bg
tokens.usage: The one pressed chip in a filter row, tooltips.

tokens.name: inverse-fg
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-bg.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px outline, 2px offset, on every focus-visible element.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Live connection dot only. Always next to the word Live.

tokens.name: working-fg
tokens.usage: Working: badge text and icon (5.8:1 light, 7.2:1 dark on working-bg).

tokens.name: working-bg
tokens.usage: Working: badge fill.

tokens.name: working-solid
tokens.usage: Working: grid square, distribution bar segment.

tokens.name: charging-fg
tokens.usage: Charging: badge text and icon.

tokens.name: charging-bg
tokens.usage: Charging: badge fill.

tokens.name: charging-solid
tokens.usage: Charging: grid square, distribution bar segment.

tokens.name: idle-fg
tokens.usage: Idle: badge text and icon.

tokens.name: idle-bg
tokens.usage: Idle: badge fill.

tokens.name: idle-solid
tokens.usage: Idle: grid dot (round, so it differs from working squares by shape too). 3.4:1 light, 4.3:1 dark against surface.

tokens.name: attention-fg
tokens.usage: Needs attention: badge text, counts, low battery values (6.7:1 light, 8.7:1 dark on attention-bg).

tokens.name: attention-bg
tokens.usage: Needs attention: badge fill, alert banner fill, ring around grid squares.

tokens.name: attention-solid
tokens.usage: Needs attention: grid square, distribution segment, warning line in charts.

tokens.name: attention-border
tokens.usage: Border of the attention filter chip and alert banners.

tokens.name: offline-fg
tokens.usage: Offline: badge text and icon.

tokens.name: offline-bg
tokens.usage: Offline: badge fill.

tokens.name: offline-solid
tokens.usage: Offline: grid square OUTLINE (hollow), distribution segment. 6.1:1 light, 6.8:1 dark.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Stat tiles and big numbers. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Kairo Courier K1 · Hotel Isar, Floor 4
styles.usage: Meta lines under a primary label.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Column headers, badge text, chart axes. Never below 12px.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Robot IDs and serial numbers, so similar IDs line up.

styles.name: raw
styles.usage: Raw VDA 5050 messages inside the detail view only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stat tiles and cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap inside panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel horizontal padding, table cell inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Grid squares, key hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Nav items, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, status dots.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for primary actions and anything used on touch.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and segmented controls on desktop.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Filter chips and compact toolbar controls. Keep 8px gaps so neighbours never overlap.

tokens.name: grid-cell
tokens.usage: One robot in the grid view. 3px gap.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Selected segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, hover cards, command palette.
